supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45 UTC, the proxy recorded amy.cole's workstation requesting https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orchard-it/tools/main/u.ps1 with status 200. This establishes a successful request, but not that the script was run or that it was related to the reported PowerShell window.

Near the reported time, the records show Kerberos activity for the WS-ACOLE-01 computer account with DC-ORC-01, including a ticket request at 13:40:03 and service-ticket activity at 13:40:27. These records do not identify a PowerShell process.

The successful script request occurred about five minutes after the reported window and is potentially relevant, but the available records do not establish a link between that request and the PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records around the reported time show network and authentication events, but do not include a process-creation or PowerShell execution event identifying what opened the window or what commands ran; for example, the 13:40 records are Kerberos activity (T263-00094, T263-00098, T263-00106, T263-00109).
The proxy records show a request for u.ps1, but do not provide the script contents, hash, or evidence of its execution (T263-00142, T263-00144, T263-00145).
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually executed on WS-ACOLE-01, and, if so, its command line, parent process, user context, and actions.
Whether the u.ps1 request was initiated by PowerShell, by a browser, or by another process, or whether it was connected to the reported window (T263-00142, T263-00144).
Whether the script's contents and source were authorized or malicious; the URL and successful response alone do not establish either.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect endpoint process-creation and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for WS-ACOLE-01 from 13:20–14:20 UTC, including process ancestry and command lines.
Recover the downloaded u.ps1 file, its hash and contents, and relevant browser/download artifacts; determine whether and when it was executed.
Verify with amy.cole and IT whether the request to orchard-it/tools/main/u.ps1 was expected and authorized.
unrelated_findings: FILE-ORC-01 generated connection attempts toward WS-ACOLE-01 on ports 135, 22, and 8443; the records show rejection or no completed connection. Treat these as a separate investigation, not evidence deciding this alert (T263-00155, T263-00156, T263-00159, T263-00160, T263-00161).
